ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and send the driver's account for review of the fake "I'm Here" arrival confirmation + flag_account
ruling.reasoning: NS-0 routes this case: the driver cancelled and asserted a rider no-show, so it goes to NS-1/NS-2 [F3][RD-3 no] — more precisely [F3][NS-0]. Under NS-1 the fee stands only if all three elements hold. (i) is satisfied on its face: the trace shows a driver_tap at 12:06:15 [F5][NS-1]. But (ii) fails decisively: at the tap the GPS put the car 600 m from the pickup, and the closest approach during the entire wait was 599 m — never within 200 m [F5][F1][NS-1]. Element (iii) also fails: the driver stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap [F5][NS-1], and the platform never recorded any arrival at the pickup point, with driver_arrived_at null [F4][NS-1]. The physical record contradicts the driver's own written claim that he "pressed I'm Here and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" [F12]; system records override statements, and the rider's contemporaneous message "I'm at the pickup point, no car here" is consistent with the GPS [F9][F1][NS-1]. With (ii) and (iii) both unmet, NS-2 (or NS-3) applies and the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full [F6][NS-2]. Because the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS showed him outside the pickup radius, NS-2 separately requires flag_account for abuse of the arrival/cancellation button [F5][F1][NS-2]; the trace also marks this ✓ and the profile field route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1 is satisfied for the driver (1 upheld no-show in 90 d), reinforcing RD-6 as grounds for account review — though RD-6 is not needed for the ruling itself [F17][RD-6]. The refund is issued as a voucher, and this remains a recommendation to Ryde [F6][NS-7]. Amount: the contested item is the fixed cancellation fee of $6.61 recorded in the fare fact, and no mileage/distance arithmetic is needed because the item is a flat fee [F3][F6][NS-2].

actions.detail: account action is never automatic; queued for Ryde review

what_would_change: Had NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both held ((ii) within 200 m of pickup AT THE MOMENT of the arrival confirmation; (iii) stayed at the pickup more than 3 min after the arrival confirmation, until cancelling (NS-1 default: more than 3 min)), the fee would stand and no refund would be due.
